activeQuestion.prompt: What should passengers do until a platform is assigned?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 月台尚未指定前，旅客應該怎麼做？

options.text: Wait at platform six and check the electronic boards.
options.zh: 到六號月台等候並看電子看板。
options.whyZh: 六號月台是紙票顯示的舊資訊，公告要求不要前往。

options.text: Stay in the waiting area but follow the paper ticket.
options.zh: 留在候車區，但之後依照紙票指示。
options.whyZh: 候車區正確，應以電子看板而非紙票為準。

options.text: Stay in the main waiting area and check the electronic boards.
options.zh: 留在主要候車區，留意電子看板。
options.whyZh: 公告要求先留在候車區，月台確定時再看電子看板的更新。

options.text: Leave the station and return for the next announcement.
options.zh: 先離開車站，下次公告時再回來。
options.whyZh: 公告要求留在候車區，沒有請旅客先離站。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 公告要求先留在候車區，月台確定時再看電子看板的更新。

group.title: Changes to a train service
group.passage: M1: Passengers for the ten fifteen train to Northbridge, please stay in the main waiting area. A signal fault has closed the eastern tracks. No departure platform is confirmed. Do not go to platform six, even if your ticket says to. Check the electronic boards instead. If this delay makes you miss a booked connection, the information desk can arrange your onward trip at no extra charge. Our next update is at ten twenty.
group.passageZh: 搭乘十點十五分前往北橋的旅客，請留在主要候車區。號誌故障已造成東側軌道封閉。出發月台尚未確認。即使車票上寫著第六月台，也請不要前往，改看電子看板。如果這次延誤讓您錯過已預訂的轉乘，服務台可免費為您安排後續行程。下次更新在十點二十分。
